skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the historical development and current state of the Vietnamese economy.
Analyze the formation of market economy foundations in Vietnam.
Collect, analyze, and report economic data.
Conduct independent research and work in groups to solve economic problems.
Critically evaluate economic issues from multiple perspectives.
Effectively present research findings and economic issues.
Develop the ability to self-study and research economic topics.
Demonstrate professional ethics and responsibility in economic analysis.
